article.story: BOONE, N.C. -- — Aaron Clark blocked a PAT in overtime, Malachi Singleton followed with the winning touchdown pass to Jackson Grier, and Appalachian State defeated UL Monroe 17-16 on Saturday. UL Monroe took a 10-7 fourth-quarter lead on Austin Carlisle's 18-yard touchdown pass to Bryce Anderson. The lead held up until 2 seconds remained in regulation when Appalachian State's James London tied it with a 22-yard field goal. In overtime, Carlisle's 1-yard touchdown run gave the Warhawks a 16-10 lead but Clark came through with the blocked PAT. Singleton hit Grier with a 25-yard pass on App State's first play and London made the PAT for the win. Singleton was 19-for-32 passing for 188 yards with two touchdowns and Treyaun Webb had 93 yards rushing for the Mountaineers (7-4, 4-3 Sun Belt). Carlisle was 16-of-22 passing for 167 yards for the Warhawks (2-9, 2-5). Jabari Tiller had nine solo tackles, 14 total. Up next App State: The Mountaineers play their regular-season finale at South Alabama on Friday.
